Graduate Enrollment Status
Fall and Spring Semesters:
Graduate students registered for a minimum of 9 credits are considered full-time, registrations for 7 credits are considered 3/4-time, and registrations for 4.5 credits are considered half-time. Exceptions are noted below.
Summer Semesters:
Graduate students registered for a minimum of 6 credits are considered full-time, registrations for 4.5 credits are considered 3/4-time, and registrations for 3 credits are considered half-time. Exceptions are noted below.
Thesis/Dissertation Credits:
Master's degree students who have completed all required coursework as listed on their approved Plan of Study and are only enrolled in thesis credits remain eligible for minimum half-time equivalency with an enrollment of at least 3 credits.
Doctoral degree students who have advanced to candidacy, have completed all required coursework as listed on their approved Plan of Study and are only enrolled in dissertation credits remain eligible for minimum half-time equivalency with an enrollment of at least 3 credits.
All graduate students who have completed all coursework and thesis/dissertation credits as listed on their approved Plan of Study and are only enrolled to satisfy continuous enrollment requirements to complete their thesis or dissertation may petition to be classified as full-time graduate students with an enrollment of at least 1 credit.
GRADUATE ENROLLMENT ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS
INTERNATIONAL STUDENTS
International students who wish to register for reduced credit hours are required to complete the
Reduced Course Load Form
and should work directly with the
Center for Global Engagement.
GRADUATE TUITION BENEFITS
The Graduate College will verify enrollment status for graduate tuition benefits through Banner and direct communication with academic departments as necessary (Form 14 is no longer used).
Graduate students on tuition waiver remain eligible for 100% tuition benefits if at least
one
of the enrollment criteria listed below is met:
Enrollment of a minimum of 9 approved credit hours in fall/spring (no minimum enrollment requirement in summer, pending all other eligibility requirements are met)
Enrollment in a minimum of 1 approved credit hour of minimum half-time equivalent coursework (thesis/dissertation credit, advanced research, directed independent research, directed independent study, internship, practicum, etc.).
Final semester of study
Approved
Form 10
petition (GC will review registration for students on tuition waivers and reach out to departments directly if a Form 10 is required)
ALL GRADUATE STUDENT EMPLOYEES (GTAs, GRAs, GAs, and GSWs)
Required enrollment status for graduate student employment is as follows (to read the full policy, click here):
Domestic Graduate Student Employees: must be registered for a minimum of 4.5 credit hours in fall/spring to remain eligible for student employment;
exceptions:
Final semester of study
Registration in a minimum of 1 credit of eligible coursework (thesis/dissertation credit, advanced research, directed independent research, directed independent study, internship, practicum, etc.).
Summer semester (no minimum enrollment requirement for domestic students)
International Graduate Student Employees: must be registered for a minimum of 9 credit hours in fall/spring to remain eligible for student employment;
exceptions:
Final semester of study
Reduced course load approval from Center for Global Engagement
Summer semester, unless the student begins program of study during the summer semester
GRADUATE ENROLLMENT STATUS RESOURCES
General Graduate Enrollment Status Inquiries: Please contact graduatecollege@fau.edu or 561-297-3624
International Students:
F-1/J-1 students should contact the Center for Global Engagement to complete the Reduced Course Load Form for authorization to enroll in less than 9 credit hours in the Fall or Spring (and Summer if it is the first term of enrollment)
Financial Aid:
Please contact the Financial Aid office at 561.297.3530 or by visiting the Financial Aid office in Building SU-80, Room 233
